ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.description: Digest identifies immutable bytes using a named digest algorithm.

algorithm.description: algorithm identifies the canonical digest algorithm, for example sha256.

hex.description: hex is the lower-case encoded digest value.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.title: Digest

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.description: Identifier is an opaque, stable identifier within a declared namespace.

namespace.description: namespace prevents an identifier string from crossing a domain boundary.

value.description: value is opaque to consumers and must be non-empty after boundary validation.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.title: Identifier

ouroboros.contracts.v1.SourceRevision.js.description: SourceRevision records immutable source metadata and its deletion/ACL epochs.

aclEpoch.description: acl_epoch invalidates stale grants and projections.

byteLength.description: byte_length is the exact source byte count.

contentDigest.description: content_digest identifies exact immutable source bytes.

deletionState.description: deletion_state is current canonical deletion state.
deletionState.title: Deletion State

encryptionKeyEpoch.description: encryption_key_epoch identifies the envelope-key epoch used for the bytes.

mediaType.description: media_type declares the received media type.

observedAt.description: observed_at records when the source was observed.

provenanceDigest.description: provenance_digest binds transformation and collector provenance.

sourceObjectId.description: source_object_id identifies the connector-scoped source object.

sourceRevisionId.description: source_revision_id is an opaque immutable revision identity.

upstreamRevision.description: upstream_revision is the connector's opaque version marker.

validFrom.description: valid_from is the earliest asserted real-world validity time.

validUntil.description: valid_until ends the asserted validity interval when known.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.SourceRevision.js.title: Source Revision
